Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect even when an opponent's Digimon is deleted in a battle with my Security Digimon?

Effect: {Hand}[Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (When this card would move from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 4 memory.)
